tasks.name: The cloud slot in the config
tasks.description: config.load reads cloud_-prefixed slot keys into settings.cloud; a cloud slot that fails a check is dropped, never replaced by the default backend.
acceptance: lua tests/test_config.lua passes every assertion
With no cloud_ keys, settings.cloud is nil and every earlier assertion passes unchanged
An unset cloud key takes the default, not the local slot's value; allow_remote, max_chars and debug_log are shared
A cloud slot failing the adapter or trust check is dropped with one warning that names no value; the local slot is untouched

tasks.name: Ctrl+Shift+B in decide
tasks.description: decide returns switch_backend for Ctrl+Shift+B, uppercase or lowercase B, in every phase, with or without a draft.
acceptance: lua tests/test_decide.lua passes every assertion
Ctrl+Shift+B is switch_backend in idle, result and error, draft empty or open; the Lock bit is ignored
Its release, Ctrl+B, Shift+B, and Ctrl+Shift+B with Alt or Command are not; Ctrl+Shift+T stays native

tasks.name: The active slot and the cloud marker
tasks.description: ime_translate_shared holds the process-wide active slot, read from and written to ime_translate.active; session marks a result or error from a non-loopback URL.
acceptance: lua tests/test_shared.lua and lua tests/test_session.lua pass every assertion
No active file, anything but cloud, or cloud with no cloud slot starts on local; cloud is remembered across a new Lua state
switch() with no cloud slot returns nil, stays local and writes nothing; a failed write still switches and reports it
Both Keychain keys are read once, at ensure; the tests never touch ~/Library or run security
A cloud result shows '  ☁ text', a cloud error '  ☁ ✗ reason'; clear drops the mark; callers passing no cloud flag are unchanged

tasks.name: The processor switches and translates with the active slot
tasks.description: switch_backend voids a translation on screen, switches the slot and turns a notice switch on and off; translate uses shared.current() and marks cloud answers by URL.
acceptance: lua tests/test_processor.lua passes every assertion, and scripts/run_tests.sh passes
The switch commits nothing, keeps the draft, and voids a translation on screen; the next Enter translates the same draft with the other slot's settings and key
Each outcome turns its notice switch on then off: local, cloud, no cloud slot
The marker follows the URL: a local slot pointed at a remote URL is marked
The tests write the active file only to a temporary path

tasks.name: Schema notices, template, README
tasks.description: The schema declares three notice switches hidden from the switcher menu; the config template and the README describe the two slots and Ctrl+Shift+B.
acceptance: Every notice switch the processor names is declared, with an empty first state and an abbrev equal to its states
The template and the README show the cloud_ keys, Ctrl+Shift+B, the ☁ marker and the no-fallback rule
scripts/run_tests.sh and the hook tests pass
